name: Microsoft Designer Keyboard (Bluetooth)
notes: 162-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real Microsoft Designer Keyboard, from the Android CTS input test data for the device: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/cts/+/1daba777fa1cc472226da4104041849ccbc65b80/tests/tests/hardware/res/raw/microsoft_designer_keyboard_register.json#10. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile. The descriptor names the vendor report 0x27 first, but the keyboard sends its keys as report 0x01 (the same CTS commit, microsoft_designer_keyboard_keyeventtests.json, "Press A": 01 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00), so dataReportId is 0x01.
